confidence_notes: Interlaken price aggregates support the meal, coffee and beer estimates, but report only eight recent contributors. Wine uses a local house-wine range; cocktail is estimated at roughly twice the draft-beer price. Accommodation estimates reflect July high-season demand and are holistic, not based on live listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink estimates use Interlaken-specific aggregate prices. Accommodation reflects the Swiss Alpine tourism market and July peak demand; no direct city comparator was used.
